description: This file defines API endpoints for managing emoji reactions within a sports live streaming platform. It includes routes for listing emojis, submitting user reactions, and fetching reaction summaries for specific events, with authentication and real-time WebSocket broadcasting features.

methods.name: list_emojis( pageNo: int = Query(1, ge=1, description="Page number"), pageSize: int = Query(10, ge=1, le=100, description="Page size"), current_user_id: str = Depends(get_current_user_id) )
methods.description: Fetches a paginated list of available emojis for reactions during live events, requiring JWT authentication.

methods.name: create_emoji_reaction( reaction_request: EmojiReactionRequest, current_user_id: str = Depends(get_current_user_id) )
methods.description: Records a user's emoji reaction for a live event, validates inputs, stores the reaction, updates the reaction summary, and broadcasts the update via WebSocket.

methods.name: get_event_reactions( event_id: str, user_id: Optional[str] = Depends(optional_auth) )
methods.description: Retrieves the aggregated reaction counts and top emojis for a specific event, with optional user authentication.
